name: Azure
summary: Azure resources, with your Azure sign-in.
description: Microsoft's Azure server, run locally: storage, Cosmos DB, Key Vault metadata, monitoring and many more services, using the account signed in with the Azure CLI. It needs Node.js.

probe.note: Invocation from the vendor's documentation, pinned to @azure/mcp@3.0.0, the newest stable release published on 2026-11-11. The catalog never starts it unpinned.
